overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law on any of three allegations: the executive session purpose was proper, minutes withholding was permitted, and the response to the minutes request was timely.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly entered executive session at its July 12, 2016 meeting without a proper statutory purpose, to approve and release earlier executive session minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to release July 12, 2016 executive session minutes and improperly withheld them until November 29, 2016.
Board allegedly failed to respond appropriately to a records request for executive session minutes made in October 2016.
allegations.key_passage: Because that response was made within 10 days of the request, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.
